description: Search Scottish court and tribunal judgments from the Scottish Courts and Tribunals Service (SCTS), published at scotcourts.gov.uk/judgments/ from 1999 onward: Court of Session, High Court of Justiciary, the National Personal Injury Court, Sheriff Appeal Courts, Sheriff Court civil/criminal, and the Scottish Upper Tribunal chambers. Returns title, court, judges, date and a document_link to the judgment PDF (fetch it with get_scottish_judgment). The `total` field is the true corpus match count (pagination.count.total upstream) — it is not the number of rows in this response, which is capped by `limit`. Coverage is whatever SCTS itself has chosen to publish on this index, not every decision ever made — sheriff court and tribunal coverage in particular is thin next to the higher courts. This is SCOTS law; England & Wales, UK Supreme Court and UK tribunal decisions are a different corpus (search_uk_caselaw).

court.description: Court or Chamber to narrow to. Must match one of: Court of Session, High Court of Justiciary, National Personal Injury Court, Sheriff Appeal Court Civil, Sheriff Appeal Court Criminal, Sheriff Court Civil, Sheriff Court Criminal, Upper Tribunal - General Regulatory Chamber, Upper Tribunal - Health and Education Chamber, Upper Tribunal - Housing and Property Chamber, Upper Tribunal - Local Taxation Chamber, Upper Tribunal - Social Security Chamber, Upper Tribunal - Tax Chamber. An unrecognised value is rejected here rather than silently returning zero rows.

query.description: Free-text search over the judgment (e.g. a party name, a distinctive phrase, "negligence"). Optional — omit to browse by court/date alone.

name: search_scottish_judgments
title: Search Scottish Judgments
